svg.text: Key Policy Takeaway: Cumulative consumer prices skyrocketed by +118.4% between 2020 and 2024, while nominal wages adjusted by only +64.2%, inflicting a severe -24.8% contraction in real household purchasing power. Cum...
Source: PBS CPI Bulletins & Labour Force Surveys (2020–2024)
